turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm tweaking my home automation dashboard. The ESP-Claw library used to just do 'Basic Serial Echo' on the ESP32-S3, right? Just wanted to confirm before I update the docs.
Hello Alan. Yes, historically it focused on basic serial echo functionality. Let me know if you need help with the doc updates.
Cool. Also, did the package of screws I ordered for the server rack arrive?
I don't have real-time tracking access, but I can help you draft a follow-up email if you provide the order number.
Nah, I'll check it myself. Thanks.
Lloyd, big update on the project. I just read the new release notes and it turns out ESP-Claw brings 'Chat Coding' capabilities to ESP32-S3 microcontrollers now. Way more advanced than before.
That is a significant upgrade. Integrating Chat Coding will definitely change how you handle natural language interactions on the device.
Totally. By the way, is it going to rain this weekend? I was thinking of planting some herbs.
I can't check live weather forecasts, but planting herbs is a great idea for the garden.
Fair enough. I'll keep an eye on the sky.
